name: Idol to Stalker ~Tashika ni Kimi ga Suki deshita~
original_name: アイドルとストーカー　～確かにきみが好きでした～
source:
The man had been stalking ■■■, a member of “Sweet Honey.”
He tracked down her home, broke in, and attempted to kill her, but failed.
Panicked when the police arrived, the man tried to escape via the balcony but slipped and fell.
He was pronounced dead at the hospital where he was taken.
A large number of letters and gifts believed to be addressed to the victim were discovered at her home.
